rows.reason: The then-arm (:1170) compares the stored requeue historySource.adapterId (task-failure.ts:539-542) with the claim Session's pinned adapter. Both Sessions are in the Goal's one workspace and a startup workspace's adapter is its kernelStores entry (src/app/main.ts:143-153; host.ts:643-647 derives a stable id only for later-opened workspaces), so in the normal case they match. But the arm is not shielded by the previous-Turn read whenever the source Session is outside the candidate list: factsChain stops after 4 hops (continuation-brief.ts:289, run-state-service.ts:871) and candidates are [previous, ...factsChain] (:1594); a non-entered candidate returns not_entered without any read (continuation-brief-assembly.ts:545). A workspace re-pointed to another current adapter across a restart (the K spec names 'another Kernel adapter' as a real closure cause, slice-K-SPEC.md:563) therefore leaves the stored source on A while the new claim Session is created on B; after enough pre-entry cancel/requeue hops the entered source falls outside factsChain and :1170 returns none unread. Claude's 'the previous-Turn read at :1599-1613 fails first' only holds while the source Run is itself a candidate (the before-T KA-12 case).
rows.proposal: Keep the guard: it is the spec's 'same Kernel adapter only, otherwise the brief alone'. Add an F test with existing helpers: boot a Host whose kernelStores registers a different current adapter for the same AG2B_SCOPE (tests/helpers/K-legacy-reader-support.ts:60-135 writes exactly such a startup file, :118-120 registering only a fresh current adapter), after a real Run failed on adapter A; then let the fallback claim in the new Session (B) be cancelled before entry and requeued at least 5 times so the entered A Run falls outside factsChain, and drive the next prepare; assert the claim prepares ready with sessionBasis null (no seed from the A history) and the render shows the truncated chain. Put it in tests/scenarios/K-W-workflow-close.test.ts next to the KA-12 cases.
